Interviewer: This intake belongs only to the Republic of Alderhaven, a fictional demonstration jurisdiction.
Caller: I am Yani Rill. The other spouse is Dova Rill.
Caller: I currently live at 89 Demonstration Row Sampletown.
Caller: We married on 2010-10-23.
Caller: There are two children of our marriage.
Caller: One is Kiri Rill born 2014-02-16.
Caller: The other is Kira Rill born 2018-02-16.
Caller: We separated on 2025-03-12.
Caller: End our marriage.
Caller: My proposed meeting place for exchanging the children is Sampletown Example Library rear gate.
Interviewer: Is that the place you want kept in the draft?
Caller: Correction: the exchange location should be Sampletown Example Library front steps.
Caller: The library is only a proposed meeting place; it is not my home address.
